title: Ex-Rep. Dong Gonzales pleads not guilty to graft over alleged conflict of interest
summary: Former Pampanga Third District Rep. Dong Gonzales pleaded not guilty on Friday to a graft charge over an alleged conflict of interest involving a P264-million flood control project.
